summary: End-to-end verified the unified Wallet feature (backend + frontend). Registered a fresh customer, navigated via Quick Actions to /wallet, added a bank payout method, filed a bank Deposit request (TT$100), approved it in Admin > Finance & Zones > Wallet Requests, then confirmed customer wallet balance updated to TT$100.01 and 'bank deposit (admin-approved)' transaction rendered. Verified withdraw client-side validation blocks amounts > balance (no request created). Impersonated Tracy Fortune (driver) and a business user via admin Users list Open-portal — both DriverDashboard and VendorDashboard show working Wallet buttons that navigate to /wallet and render the shared WalletPage. /wallet no longer redirects to /dashboard.

test_results.customer_wallet_access: PASS - /login → /dashboard → quick-action-wallet → /wallet renders WalletPage. Balance card in TT$, Deposit/Withdraw/Add buttons all visible.
test_results.add_payout_method_bank: PASS - wallet-add-method-dialog → bank fields → wallet-method-save-btn. Republic Bank ••••7890 shown under Payout destinations (wallet-methods-list).
test_results.deposit_bank_request: PASS - wallet-deposit-btn → 100 in amount → wallet-deposit-bank-btn. Pending row 'Deposit · Bank  TT$100.01 Pending' shown in wallet-pending-requests. Backend GET /api/wallet/funding-requests returned single pending 'deposit/bank/14.75 USD' as expected (100 TT$ / 6.78).
test_results.paypal_button_present: PASS - wallet-deposit-paypal-btn exists in dialog (not clicked; PayPal redirect is a real call).
test_results.withdraw_validation: PASS - With balance 0, entering 1000 + selecting saved method + submit did NOT create a withdraw request (verified via API — only the deposit remained pending). Toast is fired by client (usd > balanceUSD guard).
test_results.admin_approval_deposit: PASS - /admin → admin-tab-wallet → approve-<req-id>. Request left the pending list. Customer re-logged in, /wallet balance became TT$100.01 and wallet-transactions shows 'Deposit — bank deposit (admin-approved) +TT$100.01'.
test_results.driver_portal_wallet_access: PASS - admin-tab-users → open-portal-btn-82b3489b-6268-42c5-be1c-c5af4b819edd (Tracy Fortune, driver) → /driver-dashboard. driver-wallet-btn visible; click → /wallet loads WalletPage (balance TT$0.00). Exit impersonation returned to /admin.
test_results.merchant_portal_wallet_access: PASS - Users list Open-portal for user id ccbdcd83-8c6a-4344-a91a-7c2854b91c26 (business) → /vendor-dashboard. vendor-wallet-btn visible; click → /wallet loads WalletPage. Exit impersonation returned to /admin.
test_results.regression_wallet_no_redirect: PASS - GET /wallet as admin renders WalletPage (data-testid=wallet-page). Previously redirected to /dashboard — fixed.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminUsers/Approvals/Applicants use window.confirm() for impersonation which blocks the calling click; automated tests must dispatch the click via DOM (page.evaluate) or register an async dialog handler *before* the click. Consider replacing with an in-app modal (Dialog) for testability and better UX.

WalletPage.WithdrawDialog client-side balance check uses a hardcoded epsilon of 0.001 USD but user typed values are in the *display* currency (TT$). Rounding through toUSD may allow tiny overdrafts; backend should authoritatively reject overdraft withdrawals — verify /api/wallet/funding-request enforces balance for direction=withdraw before publishing.

There is no visual TT$/US$ toggle inside WalletPage; the currency comes from a global CurrencyContext. Some users may want to see USD balances since the ledger is USD — a small currency toggle in the balance card would help.
wtest_1785418176 (and older wtest_1785418055) test users leak into pending admin queue. Consider a dev-only cleanup or filter for TEST_* emails when running QA.

success_rate.backend: 100% (endpoints exercised via UI + curl for register/wallet/funding-requests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 flows: wallet page load, add method, deposit bank, withdraw validation, admin approve, balance/txn refresh, driver wallet, merchant wallet, /wallet regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Impersonation uses window.confirm; tests must call the open-portal button via page.evaluate(...).click() or register `page.on('dialog', d=>d.accept())` before invoking. AdminWalletRequests lives under admin-tab-wallet (Finance & Zones → Wallet Requests). Wallet amounts on UI are in TT$ (rate 6.78) and converted to USD before hitting /api/wallet/funding-request. wallet-transactions test id is on the transactions container (empty state shows 'No transactions yet.' text instead of the container).
